bottom_line: In UA/NSTEMI CYP2C19 reduced metabolizers, prasugrel vs clopidogrel was estimated to reduce the composite of CV death, non-fatal MI, or non-fatal stroke (RR 0.57; 95% CI 0.39–0.83).
implications: These integrated TRITON-TIMI 38 estimates suggest a substantial reduction in the composite primary outcome with prasugrel vs clopidogrel in CYP2C19 reduced metabolizers (RR 0.57; 95% CI 0.39–0.83; 8.5% vs 15.0% over 15 months), while in CYP2C19 extensive metabolizers the composite risks were similar (RR 0.98; 95% CI 0.80–1.20; 9.6% vs 9.8%); bleeding increased overall with prasugrel vs clopidogrel (5.0% vs 3.5%).

major_points.text: This was a secondary analysis using published TRITON-TIMI 38 summary results (not individual patient data).
major_points.quote: this study was a secondary analysis that utilized summary relative risk (RR) estimates that have been previously reported rather than individual patient data from the TRITON-TIMI 38 trial.

major_points.text: TRITON-TIMI 38 randomized 13 608 ACS patients with scheduled PCI to prasugrel vs clopidogrel for 6–15 months with specified dosing.
major_points.quote: randomly assigned 13 608 patients with moderate-to-high-risk ACS with scheduled PCI to receive prasugrel (60-mg loading dose and 10-mg daily maintenance dose) or clopidogrel (300-mg loading dose and 75- mg daily maintenance dose) for 6–15 months

major_points.text: The TRITON-TIMI 38 primary outcome was a composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal stroke, and non-fatal MI.
major_points.quote: The primary outcome for the TRITON-TIMI 38 trial was the composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal stroke, and non-fatal MI events

major_points.text: Most TRITON-TIMI 38 participants had UA/NSTEMI and the median age was 61 years.
major_points.quote: Approximately 74% of the trial participants had UA or NSTEMI, and the median age was 61 years

major_points.text: In the estimated UA/NSTEMI CYP2C19 RM subgroup, the composite outcome risk was lower with prasugrel than clopidogrel.

analysis_methods.text: Analyses based exclusively on published TRITON-TIMI 38 results, using summary RR estimates.
analysis_methods.quote: The analyses comprising this study were based exclusively on published results of the TRITON-TIMI 38 trial.

analysis_methods.text: Event risks for EM and RM were estimated by adjusting overall UA/NSTEMI event rates using genotype differences from the genetic substudy.
analysis_methods.quote: The event risks of the CYP2C19 EM and RM subgroups were estimated by adjusting the overall UA/NSTEMI trial event rates for the CYP2C19 genotype differences found in the genetic substudy

analysis_methods.text: Sensitivity analysis assumed CYP2C19 had no effect on prasugrel outcomes.
analysis_methods.quote: A sensitivity analysis was undertaken to deter- mine the effect of including the prasugrel–CYP2C19 associa- tion, assuming that the CYP2C19 genotype had no effect on prasugrel outcomes.

criticisms.text: Only a subset (~20%) of TRITON-TIMI 38 was included in the genetic substudy.
criticisms.quote: Only a subset of the TRITON-TIMI 38 population ( 20%), however, was included in the genetic TRITON-TIMI 38 substudy.

criticisms.text: Event rates in the genotyped subset were generally lower than in the overall trial, particularly for clopidogrel.
criticisms.quote: The event rates in the genotyped subset were generally lower than those reported in the overall trial, particularly for those allocated clopidogrel [4,14,15].

criticisms.text: Genetic substudy publications did not describe how genotyped participants were selected and did not discuss event-rate differences vs the overall trial.
criticisms.quote: do not include details of how the subset of individuals genotyped was selected, and do not mention or discuss the differences in event rates as compared with the overall trial.

criticisms.text: It was not possible to estimate separate effects for intermediate vs poor metabolizers because they were grouped together as reduced metabolizers.
criticisms.quote: CYP2C19 IMs and PMs were grouped together as CYP2C19 RMs in the published results of the genetic substudy. Consequently, it was not possible to estimate the comparative effects

criticisms.text: No published results compared prasugrel and clopidogrel separately in UA vs NSTEMI subgroups, so the analysis assumed equivalence.
criticisms.quote: as there are no published results for the comparative efﬁcacy of clopidogrel and prasugrel in the UA and NSTEMI subgroups separately, it is not possible to be certain that the utility of CYP2C19 genotyping is equivalent

criticisms.text: FDA considered the analysis exploratory due to differences in event risks between the genetic subset and the overall trial.
criticisms.quote: Because of the differences in event risks between the genetic subset and the overall trial, the FDA considered the analysis of such data to be exploratory, but worthy of further study [24].
